"""Capture raw quality results before a final manifest exists."""

import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.record import ROOT, digest

FINAL = Path("specs/001-enroll-course/evidence/final")


def commands(root: Path) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    bin_dir = root / ".venv/bin"
    checks = root / FINAL / "checks"
    return {
        "tests": [
            str(bin_dir / "coverage"),
            "run",
            "-m",
            "pytest",
            "--junitxml=" + str(checks / "tests.xml"),
            "-q",
        ],
        "architecture": [str(bin_dir / "pytest"), "tests/architecture", "-q"],
        "imports": [str(bin_dir / "lint-imports")],
        "typing": [str(bin_dir / "mypy"), "src"],
        "lint": [str(bin_dir / "ruff"), "check", "."],
        "format": [str(bin_dir / "ruff"), "format", "--check", "."],
        "coverage-report": [str(bin_dir / "coverage"), "report", "--fail-under=100"],
        "coverage-data": [
            str(bin_dir / "coverage"),
            "json",
            "-o",
            str(checks / "coverage.json"),
        ],
    }


def run_checks(
    root: Path, selected_commands: dict[str, list[str]] | None = None
) -> int:
    selected = selected_commands if selected_commands is not None else commands(root)
    target = root / FINAL / "checks"
    target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    failed = False
    for name, command in selected.items():
        before = digest(root)
        started = time.time_ns()
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, text=True, capture_output=True)
            code, stdout, stderr = result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr
        except OSError as exc:
            code, stdout, stderr = 127, "", str(exc)
        state = {
            "command": command,
            "stage": name,
            "exit_code": code,
            "stdout": stdout,
            "stderr": stderr,
            "digest": before,
            "digest_after": digest(root),
            "started_ns": started,
            "finished_ns": time.time_ns(),
        }
        output = target / f"{name}.json"
        if output.exists():
            archive = target / "history"
            archive.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            (archive / f"{started}-{name}.json").write_bytes(output.read_bytes())
        output.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2))
        print(f"{name}: exit {code}\n{stdout}{stderr}", flush=True)
        failed |= code != 0 or before != state["digest_after"]
    return int(failed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(run_checks(ROOT))

from enum import StrEnum

from enrollment.domain.models import Enrollment
from enrollment.domain.outcomes import Rejection


class Failure(StrEnum):
    MISSING_STUDENT = "MISSING_STUDENT"
    MISSING_PROGRAMME = "MISSING_PROGRAMME"
    MISSING_COURSE = "MISSING_COURSE"
    PERSISTENCE_FAILURE = "PERSISTENCE_FAILURE"
    IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE = "IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE"
    INVALID_REQUEST = "INVALID_REQUEST"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Command:
    student_id: str
    course_id: str
    credential: str | None


Result = Enrollment | Rejection | Failure


class StorageFailure(Exception):
    """A technical persistence failure, not a business rejection."""


class UniqueConflict(StorageFailure):
    """The persisted enrollment pair conflicts."""


class IdentityUnavailable(Exception):
    """Identity provider could not complete verification."""

from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Protocol, cast

from flask import Flask
from waitress.server import create_server  # type: ignore[import-untyped]  # Waitress exposes an untyped WSGI server; validate its socket contract in tests.

from enrollment.adapters.graphql.execution import Executor
from enrollment.adapters.http.app import create_app as http_app
from enrollment.adapters.identity.verifier import Verifier

from enrollment.application.enroll import enroll


def create_app(
    database_path: Path, verifier: Callable[[str | None], str | None] | None
) -> Flask:
    if verifier is None:
        raise ValueError("Host identity verifier must be configured")
    bridge = Verifier(verifier)
    executor = Executor(
        lambda command: enroll(command, bridge, lambda: Session(database_path))
    )
    return http_app(executor)


class Server(Protocol):
    effective_port: str

    def run(self) -> None: ...
    def close(self) -> None: ...


def make_server(app: Flask, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8080) -> Server:
    return cast(Server, create_server(app, host=host, port=port, threads=4))

class FlowSession(Session):

        super().__init__()
        self.existing = existing
        self.offered = offered
        self.fail = fail

    def enrollment(self, s, c):
        self.calls.append("enrollment")
        return Enrollment(s, c) if self.existing else None

    def offering(self, p, c):
        self.calls.append("offering")
        return ProgrammeCourseOffering(p, c) if self.offered else None

    def add(self, e):
        self.calls.append("add")
